title: The orbitofrontal cortex updates beliefs for state inference
goal: Reproduce the original expert-versus-naive OFC state-inference findings and task-aligned population factors from source session-level neural and behavioral inputs, together with the behavioral and OFC-inactivation comparisons and controls needed for the belief-updating interpretation. Assess improvement of the same primary empirical result only under an independently justified criterion. Report native hLDS held-neuron reconstruction as a separate empirical model-validation result; prospective forecasting or new session/animal holdouts remain separately named extensions.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Expert-versus-naive OFC state-inference signals and task-aligned population factors, interpreted alongside the source behavioral and OFC-inactivation comparisons and indispensable controls; no automatic whole-paper or every-figure requirement.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: empirical_method: Native hLDS held-neuron conditional reconstruction: the target neuron's loading is learned during training, but its test observations are excluded from latent inference. Preserve as empirical model validation, not future forecasting, unseen-neuron generalization or proof of improved belief inference.
simulation_control: Inference/divisive-model and ATI-recovery simulations remain interpretive controls where strategy claims require them; they are not independent substitutes for the empirical primary or a universal 200-simulation obligation.
prospective_extension: Future-time forecasting and new held-session/animal predictive comparisons retain separate prospective status.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
